playerCar.accuracy: Original G-Class-inspired 3D geometry using published W463 proportions (4.825 x 1.931 x 1.969 m, wheelbase 2.890 m); not licensed manufacturer CAD or an exact replica. Traffic body styles are unchanged.

station.accuracy: Municipal RATU 324 whole-building geometry retained with clean granite/copper materials. Photo-guided portal, grille, bilingual lettering, entrance clock and four tower clocks added. Fine details and inferred windows approximate.

skywheel.accuracy: 40-m landmark at published coordinates. Original animated 30-cabin geometry, interpreted wheel-plane orientation and structures.

allas.accuracy: Historical three-pool and timber-pavilion layout, reference-guided approximate placement. Not a 2026 survey. Reference photograph is not shipped in the game.

streetNames.accuracy: Bilingual names at approximate mapped-footway mounting points. NOT an exhaustive or surveyed traffic-sign inventory. Destination-board text and placements remain to be verified.
